title: Direct final-residual observation on unchanged G21K solver paths
question: What are the untouched final HeadCalc residual sum and maximum absolute compartment residual at the G21I B1 and B2 adjacent status boundaries, and do those direct values confirm the G21J/G21K criterion diagnosis without changing any solver tolerance or execution path?
rationale: G21K measured the B2 total-balance threshold on an unchanged three-backtracking path.
G21K could not measure the B1 final compartment residual because CritDevBalCp also changes the HeadCalc Fmax backtracking acceptance branch.

The reference Richards workspace retains the final residual vector after HeadCalc, including on a nonconverged solve, but the production backend intentionally does not publish that scratch through its ordinary observation surface.

research_build_observer.rule: Do not modify committed production/runtime/solver source files. Generate temporary research-build copies of the serialized reference backend and FGC44 C bridge from the pinned source blobs, adding only a read-only residual snapshot method and C entry point. Compile the semantic research library against those temporary copies, then delete the temporary source files.
forbidden_behavior: write to residual, state, solver parameters or corrector configuration
alter HeadCalc arithmetic or branch conditions
alter retry depth, max iterations except the already-qualified G21I prefix control
publish candidate, accepted state, ledger or coupling policy

execution_contract: For every frozen head execute one fresh immutable-origin G21I-style raw backend solve with max_retries=0, frozen production tolerances and the preregistered max-iteration prefix.
Immediately after that solve read the residual snapshot from the temporary research-build observer before any subsequent backend solve.
Require the solver status and backtracking count to reproduce G21I/G21K exactly.
For B2_STATUS6 require abs(sum(residual)) to lie above the G21K largest-fail tolerance and at or below the smallest-pass tolerance; require B2_STATUS0 abs(sum(residual)) <= 1e-12.
For B1_STATUS6 require max(abs(residual)) > 1e-12 and at least one nonconverged-balance compartment. For B1_STATUS0 require max(abs(residual)) <= 1e-12 and zero nonconverged-balance compartments.
Do not require the B1 untouched max residual to equal the G21K first-event tolerance because G21K already established that the tolerance intervention changes the path.
After all raw probes, reproduce the normal G16 participant status vector [6,0,0,6], counts [4,4,0,4], unchanged accepted revision/time/ledger and no live candidate.
gates: Pinned production HeadCalc, backend and standard bridge blobs match before generating temporary observer copies.
The generated observer patch contains no assignments to production workspace/state beyond local output variables.
Standard FGC44 end-to-end gate still passes when compiled from the research-build copies with the read-only observer added.
All four frozen solver status/backtracking tuples reproduce exactly.
B2 direct residual sum validates the G21K path-preserving total-balance threshold bracket.
B1 direct max compartment residual explains the production compartment-balance failure on the untouched eight-backtracking path.
The adjacent B1 status-0 residual is below/equal to the production compartment criterion on the same eight-backtracking prefix.
No committed file under src/** is changed.
pass_interpretation: PASS converts the G21K B1 occlusion from an indirect threshold statement into direct residual-state evidence and cross-validates the B2 threshold measurement. It remains numerical mechanism evidence only and does not justify changing tolerances or coupling policy.
fail_interpretation: Preserve any mismatch. Do not tune the temporary observer, tolerance, head, prefix length or production source to force agreement with G21J/G21K.
